reportedIssues: Inconsistent placement of information tags across restaurant cards: cards in the 'Fastest near you' section have time tags anchored to the bottom-left of their images, while the card in the 'Popular right now' section has its delivery fee tag anchored to the top-left of its image, creating a disjointed visual layout.

Secondary text (delivery fees, order time ranges, restaurant categories) uses a light gray color against a white background, which likely fails WCAG 4.5:1 contrast requirements, reducing readability for users with low vision or in bright lighting.

expected.reasoning: Neither reported issue describes a discount badge displaying −100%.
